name: AndSoul Sanctuary
summary: A membership wellness club on Cheshire Street, E2, with a sauna, a chilly plunge, a Pilates studio using reformer machines, a movement studio and a café. It runs a coached class programme.

music.notes: A monthly women's ecstatic dance that ends with sound healing, and regular Friday vinyl evenings at its café.

crowd: The club's own wording invites visitors to come as they are.

accessibility.notes: The club says the Sanctuary is wheelchair accessible, and asks anyone with specific access needs to message it on WhatsApp before visiting.

cost.notes: A single class is £28 and unlimited membership £149 a month. Newcomers have a three-class trial at £49.

evidence.quote: Shoreditch's club for the whole you
AndSoul Sanctuary is a club in Shoreditch, east London, built to support the whole you: move, recover and connect.
It combines a coached class programme, a 40-person Aufguss sauna amphitheatre, a 4°C cold plunge, a Reformer Pilates studio, a movement studio and the Palm Greens café
Friday night in the sauna with DJ Enrico Argentin. Heat, sound, ice baths and cold plunges.
Ecstatic Dance Culture return with their monthly women’s dance, closing with a sound healing.
Palm Greens opens Bi-weekly on Fridays with Atmosfer: plant-forward small plates, special cocktails, natural wines and hi-fi vinyl sounds by Sonoro
Come as you are and leave feeling better than when you arrived.
The Sanctuary is wheelchair accessible. If you have specific access requirements, message us on WhatsApp before your visit
A single class is £28, and first-time visitors can book three classes for £49, valid for 14 days.
Unlimited Sanctuary membership is £149 a month
